description: This file defines the ConnectConversions trait and object, providing implicit conversions and helper methods for converting SQL interfaces to Connect-specific implementations, including methods for creating Columns from proto.Expressions.

classes.name: ConnectConversions
classes.description: Trait providing implicit conversions and helper methods for Spark SQL Connect integration.

methods.description: Implicit methods casting various SQL objects to their Connect-specific implementations.
